articles.summary: Fueling Fall Wellness with Hearty Stews As the weather cools and the days grow shorter, there’s something incredibly comforting about a warm, nourishing stew simmering on the stove. A personal favorite this time of year is Bamya, a traditional Middle Eastern stew made with tender beef chunks, tomatoes, and fragrant spices like coriander,...
